description: This file defines the Vtiger_PackageUpdate class, which provides API methods for updating modules within the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions for initializing updates, handling migration, updating tables, blocks, custom views, sharing access, events, actions, related lists, custom links, and cron tasks, as well as parsing manifest files and managing module versioning.

classes.name: Vtiger_PackageUpdate
classes.description: A class to handle the updating of modules within the vtiger CRM system, including installation, migration, and various component updates.

methods.name: initUpdate
methods.description: Initializes the update process for a module, extracting necessary files from a zip archive.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs the update of a module from a specified zip file, handling module bundle scenarios if present.

methods.name: update_Module
methods.description: Executes the core update routines for a module, including version update and event firing.

methods.name: parse_Migration
methods.description: Parses migration information from the module manifest to prepare for migration steps.

methods.name: handle_Migration
methods.description: Handles the migration process by applying necessary SQL changes for module upgrades.

methods.name: update_Tables
methods.description: Updates database tables as specified in the module manifest.

methods.name: update_Blocks
methods.description: Updates UI blocks defined within the module manifest.
